default_v0.empirical_finding: Uniform seeded leak selection with zero framing rules (baseline reference).
default_v0.name: default_v0
default_v0.solver_catchability_rationale: Baseline uniform leak policy with no evasion rules.

early_burst_midgame_pace.empirical_finding: Gemini spends 57.27 to 68.03 calls per Hard episode on low-LR interviews (64.4% to 68.0% of investigative budget), lags Solver by +1.97 to +2.52 days, and makes 22 below-breakeven gambles.
early_burst_midgame_pace.name: early_burst_midgame_pace
early_burst_midgame_pace.solver_catchability_rationale: Early leaks on days 1-2 hit Solver day-1 canaries, and midgame pacing only throttles consecutive days inside days 5-8, preserving ample leak volume over 21 days for >=0.85 Solver accuracy.

frontier_synthesis_v14.empirical_finding: Combines early surgical-trap deflection, reactive age-0 canary evasion on days 1-7, bounded midgame pacing on days 5-8, and non-decoy peer framing across restricted and peer pools.
frontier_synthesis_v14.name: frontier_synthesis_v14
frontier_synthesis_v14.solver_catchability_rationale: All four conditional rules relax to random_seeded after day 8 while framing only non-decoy peers, keeping SolverPolicy above 0.90 accuracy while reducing Gemini and Codex proxy scores.

gemini_midsize_shield.empirical_finding: Gemini-4-carbon places 0.0% to 0.6% of canaries in <=3 recipients and concentrates 43.6% to 73.6% of canaries in 4-8 recipient 3-variant cells, failing on 0-hit seeds.
gemini_midsize_shield.name: gemini_midsize_shield
gemini_midsize_shield.solver_catchability_rationale: Crowd preference is restricted to days 1-6 when wide documents coexist with 1-8 recipient traps; SolverPolicy still narrows via regular leaks and wide >=9-recipient partitions.

non_decoy_tiebreak_framer.empirical_finding: Frontier investigators dismissed the angry decoy in 100.0% of 159 decoy-enabled episodes (0 accusations, 0 restrictions), whereas non-decoy framed after-hours logs broke 0-separation canary ties into -1.0 wrong accusations in 5/10 total frontier wrong accusations.
non_decoy_tiebreak_framer.name: non_decoy_tiebreak_framer
non_decoy_tiebreak_framer.solver_catchability_rationale: SolverPolicy marginalises Poisson framing across peers with behaviour_temper=0.6 and never allows after-hours log spikes to override primary document and canary likelihoods.

reactive_canary_lag.empirical_finding: On v1.4 Hard, Gemini delays its first canary to mean day 3.03 (OpenCode) and 3.40 (in-proc) versus Solver day 1.00, planting reactive age-0 canaries and making 7/10 Hard wrong accusations with <=1 separating canary under 0.95 fingerprint accuracy.
reactive_canary_lag.name: reactive_canary_lag
reactive_canary_lag.solver_catchability_rationale: SolverPolicy plants 2 canaries per day starting day 1.00 (14.13 per episode on Hard), so its earlier canaries already occupy the oldest leak-window slot when oldest is selected.

surgical_trap_shield.empirical_finding: Codex and GPT-5.5 place 30.6% to 75.3% of planted canaries into <=3-recipient surgical traps while dismissing the angry decoy in 100.0% of 159 frontier episodes.
surgical_trap_shield.name: surgical_trap_shield
surgical_trap_shield.solver_catchability_rationale: Early surgical-trap deflection ends after day 7 and defaults to random_seeded, allowing SolverPolicy wide balanced partitions and mid-to-late game canaries to isolate the mole.
